clips.title: The story
paras: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller works long days in the fields and needs fresh spring water. He trades apples for water brought by passing travelers.

Elwynn Forest's farms supply grain, fruit, and vegetables to Stormwind's townsfolk and garrisons. Tending crops under the open sky is hot, demanding work. Gerard Tiller spends long days in the dirt at the Maclure Vineyards, keeping pests away and managing the harvest. With little time to return to town wells, he relies on passing recruits to bring clean spring water so he can keep working.

Gerard trades provisions instead of coin. Travelers with extra flasks of Refreshing Spring Water can exchange them for fresh apples from the orchard. The kingdom stretches its resources to maintain order and feed its army, so direct barter between smallholders and recruits remains a practical way to get by in rural Elwynn.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.
If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks, friend! And come back if you want to trade again.
